name: Discord Media Downloader – Discord Video & Image Download Tool
description:
Discord Media Downloader is a simple and efficient browser extension that allows you to easily download all images and media files from any Discord channel you are currently viewing. Just open a Discord channel, scroll through the chat to load more media files, and click the "Download Media" button. All detected images and media files will be downloaded to your device in bulk, saving you time and effort.

Key Features:

- One-click download of all images and media files in the current Discord channel
- Supports bulk downloading for convenience
- Automatically detects media files as you scroll through the chat
- User-friendly interface with clear instructions
- Works exclusively on discord.com for security

How to Use:

1.  Open a Discord channel on discord.com
2. Scroll through the chat to load more media files
3. Click the "Download Media" button in the extension popup
4. Confirm the download in the dialog
